review_evidence: Reviewed all 28 primary Lean files (~7,169 lines); 27 contain active formal declarations and 26 contain theorem/lemma/example statements across rewriting, logic, limits, ring theory, probability, Galois adjunctions and exercises.
The root module is navigation; tutorial/exercise status is not an exclusion criterion because the checked statements/proofs are useful prior art.
summary: Reviewed GlimpseOfLean and retained the complete teaching/exercise theorem corpus.
